Sample · Medical Imaging Segmentation
Healthcare AI
Healthcare AI

Medical Imaging
Segmentation

Pixel-level segmentation of 120K radiology scans (CT, MRI, X-ray) with radiologist review for an FDA-submission computer-aided detection tool.

🧠

CT · MRI · X-Ray Scans

Pixel-level segmentation masks overlaid on radiology scans, reviewed by certified radiologists before delivery.

Project Overview

Annotators isolated tumour boundaries, organ contours, and pathological regions using the polygon tool. Each scan was labelled independently by two annotators, with a radiologist performing final QA review. Glioblastoma cores were annotated excluding peripheral vasogenic edema unless specified by client tier.

QA & Accuracy

A Double-Blind Annotation Process was applied — any case where the Dice Similarity Coefficient dropped below 95% was automatically flagged and escalated to a senior medical annotator for arbitration before client delivery.

Sample · RLHF Preference Dataset
Conversational AI
Conversational AI

RLHF Preference
Dataset

Curated 500K human preference pairs across 18 domains for LLM alignment — covering helpfulness, harmlessness, and factuality dimensions.

💬

Human Preference Labeling

Annotators ranked AI-generated responses across helpfulness, harmlessness, and factuality criteria across 18 domains.

Project Overview

Annotators evaluated pairs of AI-generated responses and selected the preferred output based on a structured rubric. Each preference pair was labeled across helpfulness, harmlessness, and factuality. Domain coverage spanned coding, medicine, law, science, and creative writing across 18 verticals.

QA & Consistency

Inter-annotator agreement was tracked using Cohen's Kappa. Any batch with agreement below 0.85 Kappa triggered a calibration session before continuation. Final dataset passed a 3-stage internal review before delivery.
